escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { escapeAsterisks: true, escapeUnderscores: false };
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
